intro: When your commercial or residential property needs reliable, long-lasting door hardware, professional Continuous Hinge Installation Silver Spring MD is the smart solution. sections.heading: What Are Continuous Hinges and Why Do They Matter?
sections.body: Continuous hinges span the entire height of a door rather than relying on two or three individual hinges at fixed points. This full-length design spreads the mechanical load across the entire door edge, which means less stress on any single point of the frame or glass panel. For high-traffic commercial doors — entrances to office buildings, healthcare facilities, retail shops, and mixed-use developments — this translates to a dramatically longer hardware lifespan and fewer service interruptions. Residential doors also benefit, particularly heavier solid-core or decorative glass-panel doors that can quickly wear out standard hinges. In a busy urban environment like Silver Spring, where foot traffic is high and buildings range from historic storefronts to modern mixed-use towers, choosing the right hinge system is a practical investment in the longevity of your door assembly. Our technicians assess your specific door weight, material, and usage frequency to recommend the correct continuous hinge profile, finish, and mounting approach before any work begins.

sections.heading: Our Continuous Hinge Installation Process
sections.body: We begin every continuous hinge project with a thorough on-site assessment. Our technicians measure the door height, evaluate the existing frame condition, and examine the glass or panel configuration to confirm the right hinge specification. Once the correct hardware is selected, we carefully remove any existing hinges or worn hardware without damaging the door leaf or surrounding frame. Mounting a continuous hinge properly requires precise alignment along the full door length — even minor deviations can cause binding, uneven gaps, or premature wear. Our team uses calibrated tools and follows consistent installation practices to ensure the hinge sits flush, operates smoothly, and closes securely. After installation, we test the door through multiple cycles, checking swing, latch alignment, and clearance. We also inspect the surrounding glass stops and seals to make sure the entire door assembly performs as a unified system. Clean, professional work is our standard on every job.

faq.q: How long does a continuous hinge installation typically take?
faq.a: For a single commercial or residential door, most continuous hinge installations are completed within a few hours. Larger projects involving multiple doors may be scheduled across one or more days depending on building access and the scope of work. We provide a clear time estimate during your initial consultation.

faq.q: Can continuous hinges be installed on glass doors?
faq.a: Yes. Continuous hinges are commonly used on aluminum-framed glass doors in commercial settings. Our technicians are experienced with glass door assemblies and take care to protect the glass and surrounding components throughout the installation process.

faq.q: What is the difference between a continuous hinge and a standard butt hinge?
faq.a: A standard butt hinge attaches at two or three fixed points along a door edge, concentrating stress at those locations. A continuous hinge runs the full height of the door, distributing weight and movement evenly. This makes continuous hinges more durable for heavy or high-traffic doors over the long term.
